text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives congratulations from members of regional and national commands of the Baath party on its 50th founding anniversary.
- Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf meets several non-aligned counterparts in New Delhi.
- Saddam receives a group of school children.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Article links the birth of ruling Baath party 50 years ago to the waging of the mother of battles, Iraq's term for the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- Iraqi terminals to receive 33 oil tankers this month.
- Egypt opens pharmaceutical exhibition in Baghdad.
- U.S. troops in Gulf live under terror.
- Editorial says Iran in coordination with guerrillas of Kurdish rebel leader Jalal Talabani poison Iranian Kurd refugees.
